description: This file defines a factory class 'MessagesModelFactory' that provides static methods to create builders for message objects and message headers within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating message builders with headers, including deprecated and current methods for constructing headers with specific message properties. The class ensures non-instantiability and focuses on object creation via static methods.

classes.name: MessagesModelFactory
classes.description: A utility factory class for creating message-related objects, non-instantiable, with static methods to build message objects and headers.

methods.name: newMessageBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new message builder given message headers, supporting generic payload types.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder (CharSequence version)
methods.description: Deprecated method to create message headers builder using string-based thing ID; recommends using the typed version.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder (ThingId version)
methods.description: Creates a message headers builder using a strongly typed ThingId.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder (Map version)
methods.description: Creates a message headers builder from an initial map of headers.
